headline: Flights into San Francisco may face a ground delay program tonight.

items.text: All seven United hubs reporting so far today are at 84% on time or better.

No FAA ground stop or ground delay program is in effect at a United hub; one is possible for flights into San Francisco (SFO) until 9:00 PM PT, and it is not in effect. Flights into Boston (BOS) are under a ground delay program until 12:30 AM ET because of heavy traffic, with delays averaging 41 minutes and up to 96 minutes.
The FAA's operations plan says a ground stop or ground delay program is possible for flights into Newark (EWR) tomorrow after 10:00 AM ET. It is not in effect.

traveler_note.text: If you are flying to Boston, check your flight status before leaving for the airport.
